meta.design_basis: 400 t horizontal cold-chamber HPDC machine, 5-point double toggle; Buhler H-400D as primary baseline (platens, tie bars, die height, ejector, injection force), Idra OLCS 400 / HPM II-400 for platen thicknesses, mass and motor. Simplified-but-realistic digital twin geometry.
notes: Units mm/deg. Global CS per bom.json: origin = center of fixed platen die face, +X toward moving/rear platen, +Y operator side, +Z up, floor Z=-1150.
Instance transform: p_global = Rz(rz)*Ry(ry)*Rx(rx)*p_local + pos (right-handed; Ry(t): x'=x cos t + z sin t, z'=-x sin t + z cos t). Only A32 uses a non-zero rotation ([0,180,0]).
Each instance carries 'bbox' = global AABB [xmin,ymin,zmin,xmax,ymax,zmax] of the part as dimensioned (mandatory features only) for self-checking.
Baseline Buhler H-400D: 4000 kN, platens 920x980, clear space between bars 580x640 -> centers 700x760 with d120 bars, die height 200-750, ejector 145 mm / 22 t, injection 43 t.
Tie bar check: 4000 kN/4 = 1000 kN per bar; M120x6 minor d = 120-1.22687*6 = 112.64 mm, root area 9965 mm2 -> 100.4 MPa (shank 88.4 MPa) < 150 MPa OK.

X stack (die closed, die height 400): A21 -220..0 | A81 0..170 | A82 170..400 | A22 400..600 | toggle 600..1625 | A23 1625..1805 | A26 to 1925 | tie bar -350..2305 (rear length covers die height 750).

Toggle (locked, links collinear and parallel to X at Z=+-400): C.x = 600+aC(140) = 740; B.x = C.x+L2(320) = 1060; A.x = B.x+L1(335) = 1395; A23 front = A.x+aA(230) = 1625. Closure: 140+320+335+230 = 1025 = 1625-600.
Crosshead (locked): E on big link 150 from A -> E=(1245, +-400); D at Z=+-200; arm DE=205 -> dx = sqrt(205^2-200^2) = 45.0 -> D.x = 1290.0; arm at 77.3 deg to the machine axis.

Toggle open check (stroke 420): sqrt(335^2-h^2)+sqrt(320^2-h^2) = 655-420 -> knee drop h=305.1, knee Z=+-94.9, big link 65.6 deg, front link 72.4 deg; E=(1333.0,263.4), D.x=1528.0; crosshead travel 238.0 (cylinder stroke 260); crosshead rear face 1598.0 < A23 front 1625. Crosshead travel is monotonic over the stroke.

DEVIATION: opening stroke is 420 mm, not the H-400D 600 mm. With inward-folding knees and pivots inside the 980 mm platen outline (Z=+-400) the knee reaches the machine axis at ~430 mm; 600 mm would need pivots at about Z=+-510.
Pin d90 shear at 2000 kN per toggle half: joint C has 2 shear planes -> 157 MPa; joints A/B effectively 4 planes -> 79 MPa. Link section 70x180: 79 MPa.
Injection: 430 kN on plunger d70/80/90 -> 111.7/85.5/67.6 MPa casting pressure; default d80. Cylinder bore 140 at 140 bar = 216 kN; intensifier 200/140 (ratio 2.04) -> 440 kN (~43-45 t).

DEVIATION: plunger stroke 500 mm (H-400D: 400). Retracted tip face X=-360 (10 mm behind pour hole X -350..-250), end of shot X=+140 = 30 mm biscuit before the parting line of the 170 mm fixed die half. 400 mm cannot span a 220 mm platen plus pour hole plus die half.

Shot sleeve A51 ends flush with the fixed platen die face (X=0); the d80 bore continues through fixed die A81. Shot position 150 mm below center (= 'alt'; adjustable 3-position shot axis, see global.shot_follow).
Rails A12 run under all three platens from X=-220 to the rear platen back face at die height 750. Platen bottoms Z=-490, frame top Z=-530.
Rear tie-bar thread covers nut travel for die height 200..750; rear platen/nuts move with die height, fixed platen end is fixed.
Tank + motor-pump and electrical cabinet stand on the floor on the non-operator (-Y) side; guard door on +Y side rides on a track bolted to the frame side.
Features flagged optional are cosmetic; if drawn they must not exceed the instance bbox.

Crosshead links: A36 x4 (2 per half, |Y| 25..55) connect E (on big link, 150 from A) to D (crosshead tongue, |Y|<=20). Locked: link E->D = (45,-200), 77.32 deg to the machine axis, D behind (+X of) E. Clamp rod+piston = A37, translates with crosshead A31; A35 is the hollow body only.

Toggle Y layers (each side of center): A31 tongue 0..20; A36 links 25..55; A23 inner lugs 60..125; big links A32 130..200; front links A33 205..275 and A23 outer lugs 205..275; split knee pins B 127.5..277.5; A22 lug -200..200; tie bar surface at |Y|=290. Side gaps 5 mm.

MOTION (kinematics.pose, s=0 locked .. s=1 open, stroke 420 kept): ejector A41/A42 rides on the moving platen inside |Y|<=120, |Z|<=170, total length 425. At s=1 the knees fold to Z=+-94.9 at X=1256.6 beside it (links/pins at |Y|>=127.5); rear cap X=1445 vs crosshead hub front 1458 (13 mm). Gap platen-back to hub-front = 620+dx_crosshead-dx_platen, minimum 438 at s=1.
Ejector rod pattern changed to (+-90,+-140) (was +-140,+-140) to fit the 240 mm wide ejector plate; ejector stroke 145 and force unchanged.
E pins shortened 420 -> 400 (flush with big-link outer faces, |Y|<=200): at s=1 the 420 pin overlapped the front links (|Y|>=205) by 2.3 cm3, hidden by the A33-A34 allowed-contact tolerance.
EJECTOR 2026-11-18 (karar 2026-11-17): fixed platen has NO ejector holes. A22 pattern kept (centre d80 + 4 x d46 at (+-90,+-140)) = A42 4 corner rods (+ optional centre rod).

A41 twin cylinders (formula): F_req = 215.5 kN (old single d140 @140 bar) -> 107.8 kN/cyl; d = sqrt(4F/(pi p)) = 99.0 -> bore 100 / rod 56 (ISO 3320). Push 110.0 kN/cyl, 219.9 kN total (22.4 t, H-400D 22 t); return (annulus) 75.5 kN/cyl, 150.9 kN total.

A41 strength (formula): tube 100x115 Lame hoop 100.8 MPa (test 1.5x 151); rear cap 20 flat clamped 0.75pa^2/t^2 = 65.6 MPa; rod d56 44.6 MPa, Euler K=2 L=370 Pcr 1827 kN (SF 17); M42x2 rod thread on return 60 MPa; tie posts M30 (As 561) 98 MPa.

A41 bridge 240x200x35 42CrMo4+QT: load 110 kN/cyl spread over d115 between posts Z+-70 (span 140): M = F/2(L/2-c/4) = 2.27 kNm; b_eff 57 (rod hole d58) -> W 11638 mm3 -> 195 MPa, Re>=650 -> SF 3.3. Length budget 425 = 205 (5 gap+145 stroke+50 plate+5) + 35 bridge + 165 chamber (145+20 piston) + 20 cap.
A42 plate 50 thick 42CrMo4+QT: rod at (62.5,0) to knock-out rods (90,+-140): M = F/2(140-100/4) = 6.32 kNm, b 120 -> 126 MPa. Knock-out rods d36 L390: 55 kN each, 54 MPa, Euler K=2 Pcr 281 kN.

Ejector Y envelope: barrels 5..120, A42 |Y|<=120 -> split knee pins (|Y|>=127.5) 7.5 mm, big links (|Y|>=130) 10 mm, A36/A31 tongue at |Z|>=140 above bridge |Z|<=100. Rear cap at s=1 X=1445 vs hub 1458 (13 mm) unchanged.

Die ejector box (A82 rear part): clamping plate 40 + rails 120 (|Y| 200..270) + cavity plate 70; A83 (back 30 + retainer 25, 370x520) at X 305..360; 24 x A84 d10 (6x4 grid Y+-25/75/125, Z -17.5..177.5) tip at X=185 (cavity floor); 4 x A85 d25 at (+-160,+-230) tip at parting X=170. Die ejection stroke 65 -> machine ejector stroke setting 65 for this die (machine max 145). A42 rods lengthened 345 -> 390 to touch A83.

A21 FIXED to frame (formula, rev 2026-11-18: 3 long columns A13 + rear stand A14): clamp 4000 kN is an internal loop (die force = sum of 4 tie-bar forces) -> net 0 on supports. Supports carry weight ~24 kN (A21 15.3 + A81 4.2 + half tie bars 4.6) and accidental horizontal H = 0.1*F_clamp = 400 kN (ASSUMPTION, not a standard) at Z=0.

A13 x3 long columns (2026-11-18, user photo ZLC300 type): lower 2 x d100 at (Y,Z)=(+-220,-150), upper 1 x d120 at (0,370); flange-to-flange 2430 (X -220..-2650); front flange OD200/220 x40 bolted 6xM24 to A21 rear face, rear flange welded to A14 stand (frame rear end X -2700..-2650, gussets to X -2000). Lower pair replaces A58 (removed).

A13 loads (formula; H = c*F_clamp ASSUMPTION, not user-approved): two lever levels z=-150/+370, H at zH -320..+320. c=0.1: lower |N|<=265 kN (34 MPa, Euler K=1 SF 6.5), upper 362 kN (32 MPa, SF 9.9). c=0.2: lower 531 kN (68 MPa, SF 3.2, EC3 curve a utilisation 0.39), upper 723 kN (64 MPa, SF 4.9). Flange bolts 6xM24 10.9 <=121 kN < preload 232. A14 (2026-11-19 tek govde + 2 kaburga t60): see parts.A14.dims.design.

A13 limits: long columns carry NO lateral (Y) load (216 N/mm) -> A21 needs a transverse key to A12/A11 (open). Injection reaction 430 kN now runs A57-A11-A14-A13 each shot (215 kN/lower column, 27 MPa). Thermal dT 20 K -> 0.58 mm over 2430 mm (open risk: shim/slotted front flange). Shot line clearances in out/olcu_2026-11-18_A13_bosluk.txt.

SHOT POSITIONS 2026-11-18 (formula + full-assembly BRepExtrema scan): global.shot_position alt|orta|ust -> Z -150/-75/0 (default alt). A51/A52/A54/A55 pos Z = z_sel; A21 shot hole + A81 sleeve bore follow; A57 saddle top local 230/305/380 (0/1/2 x 75 mm spacers). All three: 0 collisions; min gaps A55-A57 10 (vertical, constant), A54-A13 lower 20 (Y, constant), A57 saddle-A13 lower 115.5/52.6/20, A51-A13 lower flange 25/37/71, A55-A14 rib 40 (X), A54-A13_3 upper -/-/160, A55-A13_3 -/-/153, A51-A13_3 -/-/165.

SHOT POSITION LIMITS: 3 separate d140 holes impossible (step 75 < 140; range -150..+70 max) -> physical A21 vertical window 140x290 (Z -220..+70) with 2 bolted 75 mm filler blocks; model draws only the selected hole. Upper limit Z<=+70 from A55 vs A14 upper rib (Z 220, 10 mm), Z<=+150 from A54 vs A13_3. Ladle free height above pour hole under A13_3 rod: 390/315/240 mm (under front flange 340/265/190). 'ust' = machine centre (Z=0).

INJECTION REACTION per position (430 kN, line at Z_s, conservative; two-level column statics N_L+N_U=430, N_L(-150)+N_U(370)=430 Z_s): lower column each 215/184/153 kN (27.4/23.4/19.5 MPa), upper 0/62/124 kN (0/5.5/11.0 MPa). A57/A14 base overturning 430*(Z_s+530) = 163/196/228 kNm -> front saddle hold-down 221/264/308 kN (4 x M24 10.9 preload 988 kN), base bolt group 194/233/271 kN (8 x M30 10.9). X force by shear keys (friction would need 2150 kN clamp at mu 0.2): key 300x40, 30 engagement -> 23.9 MPa bearing / 17.9 MPa shear; A11 stop block weld a=10 x 960 -> 44.8 MPa. Static OK; A14 base weld fatigue per shot verified 2026-11-19 (17.8 MPa, cat 36*, SF 1.11). A54-to-A13 clamp option dropped: lower columns fixed at Z=-150 cannot follow orta/ust.
